'''Jayke Ball EBO 7 is your Lucky Number v 3''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11153">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11153 EBO 7 is your Lucky Number v 3], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 15 October 2000). == Original post ==

'''EBO 7 is your Lucky Number v 3'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' October 15, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' This Deck uses the Echo Base ops theme. Retreives big and force drain huge. IF you can track destinies, this deck is yours

=== Strategy ===

Set up echo base ops with your Baraguins and Lea if possible. Give her the electrobinocs and use her for on the edge. Get luke on Red 5. Have one ship sit at each system then just hyper escape away or use Rebel barrier (there are 2 I forgot to add). This way you can track your destinies with the binocs and know when to use On the Edge and Surprise Assult. Suprise Assult can REALLY hurt with all those sevens Figrin Dann ALmost never loses with the great destiny in this deck. Use the 3 Baraguins you can get out to lose then retrive 3 weapons or devices each turn. THis should stop some force loss, but you should do fine with your Figrin daan and On the Edge. Hasn't Lost 10-0 against DS musicians Bounty Hunters Ties BHBM HUntdown Have fun with this one.
